name: The Scrimshank Redemption
summary: In Gadgetzan, Fizzledowser seeks news of his missing assistant, Junior Surveyor Scrimshank. Scrimshank went into the Gaping Chasm, southeast of town. Now Fizzledowser asks you to find Scrimshank or the surveying equipment.

sections.title: A Surveyor Gone Missing
sections.body:
Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser has heard nothing from Junior Surveyor Scrimshank since he went into the Gaping Chasm. The last report from there spoke of more weird bugs. Fizzledowser wonders whether the bugs now hold two great regions of the desert.

He asks you to search for Scrimshank or, if Scrimshank is gone, the surveying equipment. Fizzledowser fears it may be all that remains.

sections.title: Fizzledowser's Verdict
sections.body:
By Fizzledowser's account, Junior Surveyor Scrimshank did not survive. Fizzledowser hopes his loss counts for something, given what the surveying equipment recorded.

The bugs show worrying cunning, and the research so far points to a third party controlling them. Gadgetzan and the whole desert may be in danger.

faq.answer: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser studies the desert's weird bugs in Gadgetzan. He is Scrimshank's superior.
Junior Surveyor Scrimshank was Fizzledowser's top assistant. He was sent into the desert southeast of Gadgetzan before he went missing.

faq.q: Where is the Gaping Chasm located?
faq.answer: The Gaping Chasm is a desert region southeast of Gadgetzan.
The Noxious Lair Investigation came before this step.
